caveats: Repaired additional groups use a common FP32 input convention for all arms; original source-dtype native differences are reported, not counted as property effects.
Local binding invariants are not all semantic binding.
Q_ALL controls channel-basis sensitivity; Q_P alone does not isolate binding.
Effects are conditional, signed and potentially order-dependent; no unique causal percentages.
Candidate-pair contrasts do not establish complete-C128 accuracy.
